T8:claude-sonnet-5-5:tools.note: Audited 2026-11-26 from the sidecars (development/reference/frontier55_t8_audit/audit.py; its output is filed beside it). (1) The notes are present: 6 thinking blocks in 6 of the 4,560 tool trials of Sonnet 5.5, each in the second turn of its trial, 122 to 212 characters long (1,049 characters in all). No other folder holds one. (2) The provider does report a separate count: every one of the 9,167 turns of this folder has usage.output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens, and it is 0 on every turn, the six turns with a note included. The analysis reads that field (any usage field whose name holds 'thinking', at any depth), so the zero is the provider's figure and not a misread field. (3) So the tokens of the six notes are not counted apart by the provider; they can only be inside the output tokens of their turns (358 to 2,424 output tokens per such turn). The count of section 5, 'for Sonnet, the thinking tokens between tool calls', is therefore reported as not separable, with the number of notes (6) and their length in characters. The notes were passed back unchanged in the next request of each trial (the analysis's own check, which did not halt). Six short notes in 4,560 trials cannot move a rate; no grade depends on them.
